title: Wasted Long-Dispatch Addition on Missed Mobile In-Home Collection Visits
content:
*Dispatch memo — Specimen Collection Appointments.*

The no-show charge of a missed Mobile In-Home Collection Visit carries a wasted long-dispatch addition, read from the service zone on the visit record and the notice — counted in calendar days from the booking date to the appointment date.

**Clause.** Counting calendar days from the booking date to the appointment date, a missed visit in service zone 3 that was booked three days or fewer ahead adds 20.00, a missed visit in service zone 2 that was booked three days or fewer ahead adds 10.00, and any other missed visit adds nothing.

| Service zone | Booked three days or fewer ahead | Booked four days or more ahead |
|---|---|---|
| Service zone 3 | Adds 20.00 | Nothing |
| Service zone 2 | Adds 10.00 | Nothing |
| Service zone 1 | Nothing | Nothing |

**Edges (hypothetical bookings).** Zone 3, notice of exactly 3 days: 20.00. Zone 3, notice of 4 days: nothing. Zone 2, notice of 2 days: 10.00. Zone 1, notice of 2 days: nothing.
